reference_fidelity.assessment: Excellent. The generated visual faithfully reproduces the modern modular card language of T01-modular-gtm.png: 2-column card rhythm, dark tab headers with vibrant blue numbered badges (01-06), clean light card surfaces (#ffffff on #f8fafc canvas), rounded corners (rx=16), and subtle drop shadows.

typography_and_contrast.assessment: Strong hierarchy from the bold title ('Our 6-Step ABM Playbook') down to uppercase section sub-headers, high-contrast step headers, and legible item text. Optionality note is prominently displayed beneath the title.

step_representation.step_01_and_02: 4-column matrices of tool tiles with embedded official brand marks and clean fallback badges.
step_representation.step_03: 3 distinct pastel panels (1st-Party Blue, 2nd-Party Green, 3rd-Party Purple) containing 28 signal categories with clean bullet icons.
step_representation.step_04: Clear vertical split between 4 ordered Account Awareness Stages and 3 Account Resource Tiers.
step_representation.step_05: Dual CRM connectors (HubSpot & Salesforce) feeding into a prominent unified CRM record hub with detailed sync bullets.
step_representation.step_06: Two distinct colored lanes (1-to-1 high-touch in soft green, 1-to-many scaled distribution in soft purple).

downstream_sequence_and_terminus.assessment: Horizontal 4-stage pipeline across canvas bottom. Closed-Won terminal card is rendered in warm gold (#fef9c3 with #ca8a04 border), creating a clear visual climax without connector clutter.

connectors_and_flow.assessment: Dashed slate-gray paths (#64748b, 2.5px width) with directional arrowheads guide the eye sequentially from Step 1 through Step 6 into the Downstream pipeline.

brand_and_assets.assessment: 37 verified brand marks and tool indicators cleanly embedded as safe data URIs; unrepresented reference branding or watermark is completely avoided.
